The `blowhorn config` commands. Each one's `--help` prints the same text.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`config get`](#blowhorn-config-get) | Print one option's effective value and which layer supplied it (a flag, the environment, the file or the built-in). |
| [`config path`](#blowhorn-config-path) | Print the effective global config file path. |
| [`config set`](#blowhorn-config-set) | Set a dotted key in the global config file, keeping the file's comments, key order and unknown keys as written. |
| [`config show`](#blowhorn-config-show) | Display the current global config file contents. |

## blowhorn config get

Print one option's effective value and which layer supplied it (a flag, the environment, the file or the built-in). With `--json`, the same row 'config show `--json`' carries for the option.

```text
blowhorn config get [OPTIONS] key
```

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | yes | Dotted option key, defaults.&lt;name&gt;, as `blowhorn config show --json` lists them |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` | Emit the option report as machine-readable JSON |
| `--platform` | string |  | Accepted and ignored by `blowhorn config`: this command never acts on a platform, so `--platform` has no effect here -- including a value inherited from `BLOWHORN_PLATFORM` or defaults.platform in .blowhorn.yaml |
| `--pace` | string |  | Accepted by `blowhorn config get` because `--pace` is a global flag, but this command does no paced work -- it sleeps between nothing -- so the value changes nothing about how it runs and appears only in the Pace column of the -v summary. Resolved as CLI flag, then `BLOWHORN_PACE`, then defaults.pace in .blowhorn.yaml (normal when none is set); an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |
| `--risk-profile` | string |  | Accepted by `blowhorn config get` because `--risk-profile` is a global flag, but this command does no gated work -- no Risk Profile hold, cap or pace applies to it -- so the value changes nothing about how it runs. A value after the command word wins over one before it; an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |

Also takes the [shared flags](/docs/reference/cli/shared-flags/): `--config`, `--log-dir`, `--profile`, `--exclude`, `--headless`, `--chrome-launch`, `--headed`, `--dry-run`, `--verbose`.

Examples:

```bash
blowhorn config get defaults.profile
blowhorn config get defaults.pace --json
```

Output: json with `--json`, text otherwise.

## blowhorn config set

Set a dotted key in the global config file, keeping the file's comments, key order and unknown keys as written. A key the engine reads is stored in its own type (defaults.headless becomes a boolean, defaults.exclude a list even for one name, an empty value clears the key); for any other key, true/false become booleans and comma-delimited values become lists. A value that starts with a dash is read as an option unless you end the options first: write "blowhorn config set &lt;key&gt; -- &lt;value&gt;", which is also how a refused value gets the sentence saying what a valid one is.

```text
blowhorn config set [OPTIONS] key [value]
```

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | yes | Dotted option key, defaults.&lt;name&gt;, as `blowhorn config show --json` lists them |
| `value` | no | Value to assign to the key; pass an explicit '' to clear a stored value |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` | Emit the option report as machine-readable JSON |
| `--platform` | string |  | Accepted and ignored by `blowhorn config`: this command never acts on a platform, so `--platform` has no effect here -- including a value inherited from `BLOWHORN_PLATFORM` or defaults.platform in .blowhorn.yaml |
| `--pace` | string |  | Accepted by `blowhorn config set` because `--pace` is a global flag, but this command does no paced work -- it sleeps between nothing -- so the value changes nothing about how it runs and appears only in the Pace column of the -v summary. Resolved as CLI flag, then `BLOWHORN_PACE`, then defaults.pace in .blowhorn.yaml (normal when none is set); an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |
| `--risk-profile` | string |  | Accepted by `blowhorn config set` because `--risk-profile` is a global flag, but this command does no gated work -- no Risk Profile hold, cap or pace applies to it -- so the value changes nothing about how it runs. A value after the command word wins over one before it; an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |

Also takes the [shared flags](/docs/reference/cli/shared-flags/): `--config`, `--log-dir`, `--profile`, `--exclude`, `--headless`, `--chrome-launch`, `--headed`, `--dry-run`, `--verbose`.

Examples:

```bash
blowhorn config set defaults.profile alex
blowhorn config set defaults.pace slow
blowhorn config set defaults.exclude acme,alex,meshery,kanvas
blowhorn config set defaults.logs.directory ~/blowhorn-logs
blowhorn config set defaults.logs.retention_days 365
blowhorn config set defaults.logs.retention_days -- -1
blowhorn config set defaults.exclude ''
blowhorn config set defaults.headless true --json
blowhorn config set defaults.store.organization acme
```

Output: json with `--json`, text otherwise.

## blowhorn config show

Display the current global config file contents. With `--json`, report every option .blowhorn.yaml honours instead: the value stored in the file, the environment override in force, the effective value and which of them supplied it, plus any keys under defaults the engine does not read.

```text
blowhorn config show [OPTIONS]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` | Emit the option report as machine-readable JSON |
| `--platform` | string |  | Accepted and ignored by `blowhorn config`: this command never acts on a platform, so `--platform` has no effect here -- including a value inherited from `BLOWHORN_PLATFORM` or defaults.platform in .blowhorn.yaml |
| `--pace` | string |  | Accepted by `blowhorn config show` because `--pace` is a global flag, but this command does no paced work -- it sleeps between nothing -- so the value changes nothing about how it runs and appears only in the Pace column of the -v summary. Resolved as CLI flag, then `BLOWHORN_PACE`, then defaults.pace in .blowhorn.yaml (normal when none is set); an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |
| `--risk-profile` | string |  | Accepted by `blowhorn config show` because `--risk-profile` is a global flag, but this command does no gated work -- no Risk Profile hold, cap or pace applies to it -- so the value changes nothing about how it runs. A value after the command word wins over one before it; an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |

Also takes the [shared flags](/docs/reference/cli/shared-flags/): `--config`, `--log-dir`, `--profile`, `--exclude`, `--headless`, `--chrome-launch`, `--headed`, `--dry-run`, `--verbose`.

Examples:

```bash
blowhorn config show
blowhorn config show --config ~/.blowhorn.yaml
blowhorn config show --json
```

Output: json with `--json`, text otherwise.
